The change soundly narrows the closed/unlisted-source reservation only when a readable issue-label map proves absence and the PR declares a non-global area set. Occupancy and review-row packaging share the same predicate, preserving linkage parity; empty, listed, unreadable-map, and explicit `area:__global__` cases retain the fail-closed global reservation. The new cause is correctly excluded from the global-only census while remaining in the complete reservation-cause enum. Diff-scoped self-tests exercise both producers, the lane-level consequence, strict narrowing, census attribution, and the important refusal cases with concrete non-vacuous assertions. I found no correctness, trust-check weakening, or security blocker in the diff.
